positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Development of internal- and client-facing reporting services for telecom marketing using C#, .NET Framework 4.0, Microsoft Office COM Interop, MS SQL, and WinForms.
- Development of internal- and client-facing metrics portals using ASP.NET 2.0/4.0, WebForms, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
- Development of internal-use libraries and utilities to aid IT.
- Helped move team to integrate version control into software development process, in this case moving from simple network share to Team Foundation Server.

While these bullet points cover the majority of work done and in order of frequency, this position allowed me great freedom in choice of technologies and almost full control over the entire software development life cycle. To lesser degrees some singular projects employed other technologies and practices both for personal edification and to determine if they would be of value to the team moving forward. This sort of allowance for growth is greatly rewarding and something I value in a position.

positions.title: Customer Support Representative
positions.description:
- 90%+ ratings by both employer and clients.
- 40%+ more call volume than center average.
- Support teams as interim team lead during low-staff periods.
- Mentor co-representatives in upcoming platform and technology changes.
- Assist IT, OA, and team leads in troubleshooting workstation and technology issues.
- Got a cool t-shirt from the client!

positions.title: Student Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Clarified lab goals for students.
- Helped with development and debugging strategies using Microsoft Visual Studio and C++03.
- Aided students in understanding common data structure concepts.

positions.title: Volunteer Videographer
positions.description:
- Operated camera position for numerous events, remote and local.
- Assisted with setup and teardown on-site and in-studio.
- Directed and edited one episode of a local talk show.
- Had a great time! Seriously, support your local groups.

positions.title: Open Lab Maths Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored university students in an open lab setting.
- Provided aid in understanding maths concepts from a remedial level to calculus.
- Maintained lab work area for cleanliness and safety.

projects.title: Multifunction Utility Glove
projects.description: Wearable, multifunction utility glove with access to all functionality through finger gestures. The prototype implemented a non-contact voltage detection, flash light, and laser pointer, but changing functionality would simply be a matter of soldering on a new device to the custom circuit board -- complete with surface-mount components! -- and uploading updated firmware to the microcontroller.

projects.title: Gluten
projects.description: Open source partial wrapper library for FreeGlut3 and OpenGL written in C++11 for personal use during a summer semester graphics course.
